content:
**Center Masochist**, formerly **Commando**, is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*, renamed and redesigned in the *Gone Fission* update.

Increased damage when attacking the torso.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | +75% ranged damage when attacking the torso. | 0031AEF1 | 
| ★★ | 2 | +50% ranged damage when attacking the torso. | 0031AEF0 | 
| ★ | 1 | +25% ranged damage when attacking the torso. | 0031AEEF | 

Before update 60, the perk was named "Commando." It used to have 3 ranks that provided +10%/+15%/+20% damage to automatic rifles.
